messages:
santiago: heads-up — i'm going to try a proxy-sided canary today that applies local backpressure and a fallback path. big question: who owns the decision surface, proxy heuristics or controller policy?

maria: i'd prefer controller to be the source of truth for policy, proxy to enforce short-lived heuristics when controller is unreachable. keep the contract minimal.

dev_raj: agree. tiny contract idea: proxy calls /decide?session_id=...&route=... -> {action: pass/throttle/fallback, ttl_s: 5, owner: 'eng-runtime'}

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started for proxy-backpressure v2 -> region: us-west-2, pct: 10% :rocket:

carla: concern: race between controller updates and proxy TTLs. if controller lags, proxy might keep throttling users longer than intended. need expiration + probe.

maria: proxy should do active probes against controller when in throttle state. fallback chain: 1) local heuristic, 2) fallback model route (stable), 3) escalate to controller. also emit decision_origin tag (local vs controller).

santiago: minimal telemetry we need: decision_origin, decision_ttl_s, input_hash, probe_id. that will let us correlate false positives.

dev_raj: small feature-flag plan: proxy_local_fallback = on/off. short-term implement local heuristics + ability to call /decide. i'll sketch RFC.

maria: config snippet (proposal):
```
proxy.backpressure:
  enabled: true
  local_heuristics:
    token_window: 50
    error_threshold_pct: 2.0
    ramp_ms: 200
  controller_decide_endpoint: https://control-api.internal/decide
  decision_ttl_s: 5
```

carla: also add owner and contact in decision response so oncall pages the right person: owner, pager_team, runbook_url.

santiago: +1. also we need a safe default if controller unreachable: prefer fallback to stable model over blind throttling. degrade output quality not availability.

maria: operational concern — this may spike 429s during rollout. @oncall please watch error-rate and 95p latency. set alert: 5m window, >=1% 429s => page.

oncall: ack. watching. i'll hold off manual rollback unless user impact >2%.

dev_raj: curl example to hit decision endpoint for local testing:
```bash
curl -X POST https://proxy.local/decide -d '{"session_id":"abc", "route":"text-gen", "input_hash":"..."}'
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary finished stage: still 10% traffic, no automated rollback triggered. logs: 10k requests, 0.9% 429s.

carla: nice. follow-up action items: dev_raj to draft RFC for decision API + schema, maria to add telemetry tags and runbook links, santiago to enumerate fallback ordering for each route.

santiago: i'll put a short design doc in the repo and tag architecture. thanks all. :tada:
